scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/api && composer install && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed && php artisan scramble:export && cd ../.. && nx run api-sdk:generate
scripts.compose:install: podman exec cl-api composer install && podman exec cl-web npm install
scripts.compose:env-init: podman exec cl-api sh -c 'if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.docker.example .env && php artisan key:generate; fi'
scripts.compose:migrate: podman exec cl-api php artisan migrate --force
scripts.compose:migrate-fresh: podman exec cl-api php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force
scripts.compose:seed: podman exec cl-api php artisan db:seed --force
scripts.compose:test:api: podman exec cl-api php artisan test
scripts.compose:sdk: podman exec cl-api php artisan scramble:export && podman exec cl-web npx nx run api-sdk:generate
scripts.compose:setup: npm run compose:up && sleep 15 && npm run compose:install && npm run compose:env-init && npm run compose:migrate-fresh
